@fig-deadlines-by-week-day shows a depiction of the same information in a more graphic form.

```{r}
#| label: fig-deadlines-by-week-day
#| fig-cap: "A graphic depiction of the quizzes and exams in PSYCH 260.001. The letter (q, e) refers to a quiz or an exam. The week of the semester is indicated on the vertical axis. The day of the week is indicated on the horizontal axis. Each month is in a different color."
#| echo: false
library(ggplot2)
sched_df <- readr::read_csv("include/csv/schedule-matrix.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
sched_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(day = ordered(day, labels = c("Mon", "Wed", "Fri"))) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_text(aes(x = day, y = wk, label = evt, color = mo)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title.x.bottom = element_blank()) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_y_reverse()
```
